title: Validation Report API
description: Connect-RPC service exposing read endpoints: list goldens, list skills, list manifests, latest verdict per tuple, full run history per tuple, current stale flags.

requirements.title: Proto service definition
requirements.description: proto/v1/report/report.proto defining the ReportService with List* and Get* RPCs for goldens, skills, manifests, verdicts (latest + history), and stale flags. Message types reuse domain entities (Golden, Skill, Manifest, ValidationRecord) defined in their own protos.

requirements.title: Connect handler implementations
requirements.description: api/handlers/report/connect_handler.go implementing each RPC by composing the domain repositories from OT-P0-001 through OT-P0-007. Read-only at this OT; mutations live on their respective domain services.
